Grilled Minis Skewers
By: Kevin Anderson
Published: Wednesday, September 2, 2015 - 10:51am

Ingredients




• 16 Piller's Simply Free Kolbassa Minis
• 16 small wooden skewers or toothpicks
• 45 ml (2 Tbs.) Dijon mustard
• 30 ml (1 Tbs.) honey
• 45 ml (2 Tbs.) olive oil
• 1 apple, cut into small wedges
• 1 small red onion, cut into cubes
• 1 bell pepper, cut into cubes

Preparation

1 Heat grill to medium heat. In a bowl, whisk together mustard, honey, and oil until combined. 2 Thread Kolbassa Minis with a combination of apples, onions, or peppers onto 16 skewers. Brush generously with dressing. 3 Grill for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Serve warm. 4 More information and recipe ideas are available online at pillers.com.

About

Piller's Simply Free Kolbassa Minis have 50 calories and 8 g of protein per pack of five sausages, so you can provide tasty, healthy snacks for your family in a jiffy.
